name: s81pq_root_ref-v1-023590ae7
purpose: S81 die cell dsfd_pq_root x128 (slot 132.168 x 211.656 = planner PQ_ROOT_WH 132.192 x 211.68 less the 0.024 draw shave): the pipelined ROOTD128 sibling CAM ot_s81_pq_ret_root_cam_p PAR 0 ASPLIT 0 as an M5 recipe-2 reference tile. Replaces the 10-08 legacy view (s81b-pq-rc2-a0-h212-hm10-b761ac1c6: signals to M6, PG M7, clk W / rst E, stub pins 29, child_lint (f), SS sign-off). Tree word in on N (from the pqn station), root word out on S (to the pqs station), every pin registered in RTL. Not a composition of pqc tiles (those are the PQ core dsfd_sp_pq)

bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_pq_ret_root_cam_p #(.D(128), .QD(128), .PAR(0), .ASPLIT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/proto/ot_fp32_add_rne_pipe.sv rtl/gpu/ot_fp32_add_rne_deep.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/v41rom/ot_v41_ret.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_pq_parent/ot_s81_pq_ret_root_cam_p.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: exact_cam_p
bench.cmd: python3 tools/s81/pq_root_cam_p_gate.py --out {RUN}/bench/gate --par 0 --asplit 0; rc=$?; cat {RUN}/bench/gate/record.json; echo gate_rc=$rc; exit $rc

bench.name: neg_wrong_sibling
bench.cmd: python3 tools/s81/pq_root_cam_p_gate.py --out {RUN}/bench/ws --par 0 --asplit 0 --only wrong_sibling; if grep -Eq 'pairing/result mismatch|unexpected fault' {RUN}/bench/ws/wrong_sibling.log; then echo ROOTCAM_NEG FAIL; exit 1; fi; echo ROOTCAM_NEG PASS
